feature.label: Modern Terminal
feature.description: A terminal view for Eclipse that gets CJK wide characters, alternate screen, mouse reporting, grapheme clusters, split tabs and Shift+Enter right, so that Claude Code, Codex CLI, vim and htop work as in a native terminal. Local shells and SSH, with an SFTP Files view that follows the SSH tab. Installs beside the Eclipse Terminal.
